reads.source: Gallica f640, native IIIF, four column-half crops plus native line crops of *velmors* at 1280B and of the Hebrew at 1280C. Printed corners read first: 1279 / 1280.
reads.found: TWO DIGITIZATION LOSSES, both filed as pending TEI patches. (1) 1280A: the plate sets a plain *VERS. 15. --*; our TEI carries a spurious *>* after the dash (*VERS. 15.-->*), which is markup escaping, not type. (2) 1280C: the plate sets *Sehin (Hebrew) ulcus sonare*, with the Hebrew word in Hebrew type between the parentheses; our TEI drops the word and the parentheses entirely. Read on a native crop; the four letters are shin-heth-yod-final nun. The English does not carry it (inserting non-Latin type on our side alone would break the twin pair) -- it goes in with the patch. ONE PLATE DEFECT, confirmed at native resolution: 1280B sets *Non infernus velmors.* as one fused token with no word space; [sic: *velmors*] fired, with the disjunction and the noun both carried in plain words beside the marker per 7a''''. Foot of both columns blank. [var:] fired: Is 38:7 *quia fecit Dominus* for *quia faciet Dominus* (1279D). Cruces: Mt 19:12 *qui se castraverunt* for *qui seipsos castraverunt*; Ex 32:32 quoted at 1280D without *tuo* and without the conditional clause.
